children: GE HealthCare Technologies is boosting its quarterly dividend by 14% to 4 cents a share.
The new payout, equal to 16 cents a year, represents a 0.2% yield based on the company's Tuesday closing price of $66.27.
The dividend is payable on Nov. 13 to shareholders of record as of Oct. 23.
Write to Elias Schisgall at elias.schisgall@wsj.com
